name: Modular Elements
purpose: Verify small category-aware building blocks, facet separation, exact dependencies, composition fit and honest quality boundaries.

baseline_claims.need: Identity, version, category, kind and digest are exact and portable.
Behavior, content, appearance, spatial, temporal and physical facets remain typed and category-compatible.
Inputs, outputs and exact dependencies compose without type substitution.
Context, canvas and category restrictions are checked fail-closed.
Origin, source digest, license and author seat remain visible.
Technical validity never silently becomes visual, usability or manufacturing approval.
Every admitted element can seal as an exact Universal Component Protocol component.
